parameters.name: InterfaceList
parameters.description: The list of interfaces to which a frame satisfying the following classification criteria should be forwarded (intfAddressList parameter as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 5-8: ALME-SET-FWD-RULE.request parameters and Table 5-12: fwdRuleList elements}}). {{list}} Each list item MUST be the path name of an object, which MUST be a row of an {{object|##.Interface}} object. If the referenced item is deleted, the corresponding item MUST be removed from the list. {{noreference}}

parameters.name: MACDestinationAddress
parameters.description: Classification criterion. The destination MAC address.

parameters.name: MACDestinationAddressFlag
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the classification criterion {{param|MACDestinationAddress}} is ignored. If {{true}}, the classification criterion {{param|MACDestinationAddress}} is used.

parameters.name: MACSourceAddress
parameters.description: Classification criterion. The source MAC address.

parameters.name: MACSourceAddressFlag
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the classification criterion {{param|MACSourceAddress}} is ignored. If {{true}}, the classification criterion {{param|MACSourceAddress}} is used.

parameters.name: EtherType
parameters.description: Classification criterion. Ether Type Field in a frame.

parameters.name: EtherTypeFlag
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the classification criterion {{param|EtherType}} is ignored. If {{true}}, the classification {{param|EtherType}} is used.

parameters.name: Vid
parameters.description: Classification criterion. IEEE 802.1Q VLAN ID in a frame.

parameters.name: VidFlag
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the classification criterion {{param|Vid}} is ignored. If {{true}}, the classification {{param|Vid}} is used.

parameters.name: PCP
parameters.description: Classification criterion. IEEE 802.1Q Priority Code Point field.

parameters.name: PCPFlag
parameters.description: If {{false}}, the classification criterion {{param|PCP}} is ignored. If {{true}}, the classification {{param|PCP}} is used.

object.description: The 1905 forwarding rule for the ALME-SET-FWD-RULE.request and ALME-GET-FWD-RULES.response with classification criteria as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 5-9: ClassificationSet elements}}.
